message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: CI

#on: [push]

on:
  # Trigger the workflow on push or pull request,
  # but only for the master branch
  push:
    branches:
      - master
      - Release/**
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - master

jobs:
  build:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v1

    - name: Cache Maven dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.m2/repository
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-maven-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-maven-

    - name: Set up JDK
      uses: actions/setup-java@v4
      with:
        distribution: temurin
        java-version: '17'

    - name: Run CI-apache-stable
      run: |
        ./dev/CI-apache-stable.sh

    - name: Publish Unit Test Results
      uses: EnricoMi/publish-unit-test-result-action@v1
      if: always()
      with:
        files: |
          **/test-results/**/*.xml",
  "rationale": "The workflow builds a Maven project (evidenced by pom.xml in the repository) and runs a script that likely downloads dependencies on every run. Adding a cache step for ~/.m2/repository keyed by the pom.xml files will avoid repeated dependency downloads, reducing CI time. This optimization is supported by the P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (cache dependency downloads) and the experiment example experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9 which demonstrates caching dependency downloads for a Go project; the same principle applies to Maven.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9", "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}

4. Publish Unit Test Results using EnricoMi/publish-unit-test-result-action@v1 (if always) with files pattern **/test-results/**/*.xml
